query:
UPDATE agent_configs
            SET instructions = $2,
                harness = $3,
                harness_id = $4,
                default_model = $5,
                channel_scope = $6,
                mcp_scope = $7,
                auto_accept_permissions = $8,
                is_coding = $9,
                is_ephemeral = COALESCE($10, is_ephemeral),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE bot_id = $1
            RETURNING is_ephemeral
